# Exam and Practice Persistence Boundaries

Personal-text practice and approved sample exams have different persistence rules; future parity work must retain the distinction.

## What Happened
During YKI Reading AI Coach task t3, source and tests showed that learner-submitted reading text, its questions, and its results stay session-only, while approved example exam results and answers are saved. Tutor vocabulary analyses and translations may also be cached separately. Example exams require one eligible article from each of four categories, yielding 18 questions.

## Takeaway
When changing reading or scoring flows, test user-text isolation and approved-sample persistence as separate cases. Do not interpret “user practice is not persisted” as prohibiting the separate vocabulary-cache behavior.
